front: A +1 sickle whose handle is an ever-inked pen. Once a day it lets you gain cursory knowledge of a book or other work by signing it.
back:
+1 sickle; the handle's nib works as an ink pen that never runs out.
Activate (3 actions, Interact; once per day): inscribe "read by" and your name inside a non-magical literary work (book, scroll, play). You immediately gain cursory knowledge of it, as though you had skimmed it for 5 minutes.
